description: This file defines an interface IStateMachineStorage for managing storage operations related to state machines, including reading log segments, replacing logs, appending segments, deleting logs, and checking for snapshot requests.

classes.name: IStateMachineStorage
classes.description: Interface providing storage operations for state machines, including log reading, replacement, appending, deletion, and snapshot request status.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of log segments for the state machine.

methods.name: ReplaceAsync
methods.description: Atomically replaces the current log with a new log extent.

methods.name: AppendAsync
methods.description: Atomically appends a new log extent to the existing log.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes the log of the state machine atomically.
